guard: the CPN runtime refuses a caller-supplied non-helper child role before launcher issuance and tells the caller to omit the override because the reviewed persona supplies helper
command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cpn-runtime test
completionMarker: returns remote job identity and status
why: THE FAILED BOUNDARY IS CPN-SPECIFIC. Generic Cotal runtimes intentionally allow a spawn caller
to override a persona role, while the reviewed CPN launcher admits adopted Kubernetes workers
only as helper. Before this guard, the CPN runtime forwarded role=worker and the launcher
returned invalid_child_role after the manager had already begun the remote launch path.
OMISSION STAYS VALID. A reviewed CPN persona resolves to helper without a caller override, and
the runtime also preserves undefined for compatibility with the launcher's established omitted-role
path. Only an explicit non-helper value is refused, before CpnLaunchClient.launch is called.
THE ACTIONABLE WORDING IS PART OF THE CONTRACT. The refusal tells an agent to omit role rather
than guess another launcher-only value. The named cell matches that guidance and the sibling cell
proves the invalid request never crosses the trusted manager-to-launcher boundary.

mutations.name: the CPN runtime forwards an explicit non-helper role to the launcher
mutations.expectRed: refuses a non-helper CPN role with omit-the-override guidance
mutations.cell: refuses a non-helper CPN role with omit-the-override guidance
mutations.note: This is the defect as observed: role=worker reaches launcher issuance instead of failing at the CPN runtime boundary. The unchanged sibling assertion also verifies that CpnLaunchClient.launch was called, so the red result is not wording-only.
